methodology: This review utilized scientometric analysis and Dematel (Decision-making trial and evaluation laboratory) method to delve into the impact of various factors on the efficacy of different reinforcement techniques in strengthening unreinforced masonry walls.
research_objective: To explore the efficacy of various reinforcement techniques for strengthening unreinforced masonry walls, provide a comprehensive overview of their respective advantages and limitations, and perform a detailed study of the literature regarding the effect of different strengthening systems on the mechanical properties of different categories of masonry walls.
